description: This file defines an Android activity class BasicGLSurfaceViewActivity which manages a BasicGLSurfaceView for rendering OpenGL content. It sets up the view in onCreate and manages pause/resume lifecycle events.

classes.name: BasicGLSurfaceViewActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class that manages a custom OpenGL surface view for rendering graphics.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets up the BasicGLSurfaceView.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the view rendering when activity is paused.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes the view rendering when activity is resumed.
